user.title: Connect your Ezykam account
user.description:
Home Assistant signs in by showing you a QR code to scan with the ezyKam+ mobile app. **Your password is never entered or stored.**

Select **Submit** to generate the code.

scan.title: Scan to sign in
scan.description:
![Scan this QR code with the ezyKam+ app]({qr_url})

Open the **ezyKam+** app, choose **Scan**, and point it at the code above.

Once you have scanned it, select **Submit**.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Ezykam
reauth_confirm.description: The cloud rejected the stored session. Select **Submit** and a new QR code will be generated for you to scan with the ezyKam+ app.
